title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV volume rose from 4 to 16 items week on week, driven by media reports of 16 infants infected within 20 days at a Changhua postpartum care home and a post summarising European data on maternal RSV vaccination. No item names nirsevimab or infant antibodies.
products.implication: Infant RSV prevention is entering public view through an outbreak in a care setting, and the prevention conversation is currently framed around maternal vaccination and infection control, not infant antibodies.
products.action: Prepare a neutral evidence pack on infant RSV burden and prevention options in care settings; brief pediatric and neonatal experts and be ready for health-authority or media questions if the cluster story develops. No consumer-facing messaging.
who: Postpartum care home operators and regulators
products.signal_zh: RSV討論量週增，由4則增至16則，主因是媒體報導彰化產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒感染，以及一則彙整歐洲孕婦接種RSV疫苗數據的貼文。無任何內容提及nirsevimab或嬰兒抗體。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV預防因照護機構疫情進入大眾視野，目前預防討論聚焦於孕婦接種與感染管制，而非嬰兒抗體。
products.action_zh: 準備中立的實證資料包，涵蓋嬰兒RSV疾病負擔及照護機構預防選項；向兒科與新生兒科專家簡報，若群聚事件持續發展，準備回應衛生主管機關或媒體提問。不進行消費者溝通。
who_zh: 產後護理之家業者及主管機關

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda, public programme enhanced tender (65+ in long-term care)
products.signal: Enhanced-vaccine volume fell from 82 to 27 items and high-dose from 19 to 12 after launch week. Remaining coverage is severity-driven: doctors urge adjuvanted or high-dose vaccines for high-risk older adults, and one report discusses high-dose for older people with comorbidities. Taiwan CDC says enhanced vaccine is prioritised for 65+ in long-term care.
products.implication: With record severe cases, clinicians are widening the discussion beyond long-term care residents, which may raise access and eligibility questions the public programme does not currently answer. A clinic post making comparative efficacy claims for an adjuvanted vaccine shows the enhanced category is exposed to promotional claims scrutiny.
products.action: Track and log clinic or social claims about enhanced vaccines and maintain a compliance-ready position on advertising rules; prepare burden and uptake evidence for 65+ for policy dialogue with CDC and geriatric experts on enhanced-dose allocation in future tenders.
who: Taiwan Association of Gerontology and Geriatrics
products.sub_zh: Efluelda，公費加強型採購（長照機構65歲以上）
products.signal_zh: 開打週後，加強型疫苗討論量由82則降至27則，高劑量由19則降至12則。剩餘報導以重症為主軸：醫師呼籲高風險長者接種含佐劑或高劑量疫苗，一則報導討論有共病長者接種高劑量疫苗。疾管署表示加強型疫苗優先提供長照機構65歲以上長者。
products.implication_zh: 重症創紀錄之際，臨床醫師將討論範圍擴大至長照住民以外族群，可能引發公費計畫目前未能回應的取得與資格問題。一則診所貼文對含佐劑疫苗提出療效比較宣稱，顯示加強型類別面臨推廣宣稱的檢視風險。
products.action_zh: 追蹤並記錄診所或社群上有關加強型疫苗的宣稱，維持符合廣告規範的法遵立場；準備65歲以上疾病負擔與接種實證，以便與疾管署及老年醫學專家就未來採購的加強型劑量分配進行政策對話。
who_zh: 台灣老年學暨老年醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little this week. Tdap mentions rose from 0 to 7, all tied to medical societies recommending respiratory vaccines, including Tdap and RSV, for people with chronic lung disease such as COPD and asthma. No pertussis outbreak, maternal Tdap or pricing items appeared.
products.implication: The society recommendation is a low-noise opening to place adult boosters within chronic lung disease care, but there is no public pressure or controversy now.
products.action: Monitor the society recommendation's pickup and prepare a short adult-booster evidence summary for pulmonology stakeholders; no reactive work needed.
who: Taiwan Society of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine
products.sub_zh: 成人及孕婦百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週動態不多。Tdap討論量由0則增至7則，皆與醫學會建議COPD、氣喘等慢性肺病患者接種包括Tdap與RSV在內的呼吸道疫苗有關。未出現百日咳疫情、孕婦Tdap或價格相關內容。
products.implication_zh: 醫學會建議提供一個低調切入點，可將成人追加劑納入慢性肺病照護，但目前沒有輿論壓力或爭議。
products.action_zh: 監測醫學會建議的擴散情形，並為胸腔科利害關係人準備簡短的成人追加劑實證摘要；無需被動回應作業。
who_zh: 台灣胸腔暨重症加護醫學會

issues.title: Second-stage public flu programme widens eligibility amid record severity
issues.note: Expect demand spikes and questions on brand availability at clinics, plus queries on who can get enhanced vaccines beyond long-term care residents.
issues.title_zh: 重症創紀錄之際，公費流感疫苗第二階段擴大接種對象
issues.note_zh: 預期診所需求激增，並出現廠牌供應問題，以及長照住民以外誰可接種加強型疫苗的詢問。

issues.title: Clinic promotional claims on enhanced flu vaccines draw scrutiny
issues.note: A clinic post with comparative efficacy claims for an adjuvanted vaccine was flagged misleading; similar posts could prompt regulator or media attention across the enhanced category.
issues.title_zh: 診所對加強型流感疫苗的推廣宣稱受到檢視
issues.note_zh: 一則對含佐劑疫苗提出療效比較宣稱的診所貼文被標示為誤導；類似貼文可能引發主管機關或媒體對整個加強型類別的關注。

issues.title: Follow-up on Changhua postpartum care home infant cluster
issues.note: Further reporting or official comment could turn to infant RSV prevention options and infection control in postpartum care homes.
issues.title_zh: 彰化產後護理之家嬰兒群聚後續
issues.note_zh: 後續報導或官方說明可能轉向嬰兒RSV預防選項及產後護理之家感染管制。

self_pay.title: Self-pay stock gaps reported in Kaohsiung
self_pay.note: A user reports two Kaohsiung clinics said self-pay flu vaccine will not be available until November, while Lienchiang County opened limited advance booking for self-pay doses.
self_pay.title_zh: 高雄傳出自費疫苗缺貨
self_pay.note_zh: 一名網友反映兩家高雄診所表示自費流感疫苗要到11月才有，連江縣則開放有限量自費預約。

self_pay.title: Price sensitivity is visible
self_pay.note: A widely engaged post complains about paying NT$1,950 for a self-pay flu shot, and doctors' early-vaccination advice now mentions self-pay as an option.
self_pay.note_zh: 一則高互動貼文抱怨自費流感疫苗需付NT$1,950，醫師的提早接種建議現也將自費列為選項。

self_pay.title: Clinic-led promotion of adjuvanted vaccine
self_pay.note: A clinic post invites people to get an adjuvanted flu vaccine with comparative efficacy claims flagged as misleading; whether the doses are publicly funded or self-pay is not stated.
self_pay.title_zh: 診所主導的含佐劑疫苗推廣
self_pay.note_zh: 一則診所貼文邀請民眾接種含佐劑流感疫苗，其療效比較宣稱被標示為誤導；未說明疫苗為公費或自費。

self_pay.title: No self-pay signal for RSV antibodies or Tdap
self_pay.note: Infant RSV coverage this week concerns a care-home cluster and maternal vaccination evidence, with nothing on clinic stock or prices for infant antibodies or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: RSV抗體或Tdap無自費相關訊號
self_pay.note_zh: 本週嬰兒RSV報導聚焦護理之家群聚及孕婦接種實證，未見嬰兒抗體或Tdap的診所庫存或價格相關內容。
